coverage.description: tree_form ignores comments, short rows, multiword and decimal IDs. Last punctuation ? or a raw trailing ? yields wh only when the first nonpunctuation row has a wh tag, otherwise q. A root VB with no direct subject/expletive, no earlier auxiliary, at most two permitted softeners yields imp before ! yields excl. Other forms yield decl.
